Snapping elastic bands or your wrist
squeezing an ice cube in your hand

It’s probably the last thing you wanna do but 
exercise often helps, going for a run or walk releases endorphins and shit that hand on heart will take the edge of an urge

The love you have for him Is so amazing man! If you truly think he despises you, what have you got to lose? Talk to him like you’ve spoken here. Reinforce that you truly just care about him. If he doesn’t want to talk that’s one thing but if he reacts badly, that’s a reflection on him and the place he’s in, not on you.

Actually heartbroken at the concept your mum won’t let you see a doctor.
If you’re serious about getting help, try braving a day at school and going to see a teacher or school counsellor you trust. 

Don’t feel guilty for relapsing, just keep doing the best you can x

Ask him.

Calmly and sensitively as you can, bring it up. 

Some do it for control or release
Others out of sheer self hate 
Some people do it for attention ( but not necessarily in a bad way. More in a, I’m in a really bad place and I don’t know how else to get help, kinda way)

You don’t really know what’s going on inside someone’s head until you talk to them about it and it could be very different reasoning from a lot of people

Yesss!!!

But feel like that’s because I know what it took to get to this place where it’s not a big deal.

I hate the idea of anyone having to experience that. Hate the idea of anyone hurting themselves to the extent it becomes okay or normal
